name: AscentixRulesExport
description: Exports published Ascentix Rules Engine rules from a Dataverse environment to a rule package file.
helpMarkDown: Writes the published rules of the named rule sets to a .asxrules.json package. Draft and archived rules are skipped.
author: Ascentix

inputs.name: connection
inputs.label: Power Platform service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: The service connection for the environment to export from.

inputs.name: ruleSets
inputs.label: Rule sets
inputs.helpMarkDown: Rule set names, one per line.

inputs.name: rules
inputs.label: Rules
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional rule names, one per line. Narrows the rule sets to these rules.

inputs.name: outputPath
inputs.label: Package file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Where to write the package, for example $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/rules.asxrules.json.
